create.name: Everyday Zen Foundation
create.bio:
The Everyday Zen Foundation is a Soto Zen community founded and guided by Zoketsu Norman Fischer, a poet and Zen priest who served as co-abbot of San Francisco Zen Center in the late 1990s. It practises in the line of Dogen and Shunryu Suzuki Roshi, but deliberately has no temple or property: rooted in the San Francisco Bay Area, it borrows space from partner organisations for retreats and seminars, and since the pandemic much of its life happens on Zoom. A loose family of affiliated sanghas, from California and the Pacific Northwest to Canada, Boston and Mexico, practise in the same spirit.

The idea is that practice belongs in ordinary life rather than in a special place. Members can sit together online every morning, join a weekly metta sitting, a Sunday sharing circle and a long-running Dharma seminar, and come to monthly all-day sittings, an annual practice period and a spring sesshin with Norman and senior teachers. Precepts classes prepare those who wish to make a formal commitment. Beyond traditional Zen, the foundation's work has reached into Jewish and Christian meditation, care for the dying, conflict resolution, business and the arts. Hundreds of Norman's talks are free to stream or download on a suggested-donation basis.

courses.title: Everyday Zen Daily Sitting (Zoom)
courses.description: A half-hour of zazen together on Zoom every morning, with one session on Pacific time and another early on Eastern time. Open to anyone, with no registration.

courses.title: Weekly Metta Sitting
courses.description: A short loving-kindness sitting held online each Monday morning, Pacific time, using the community's regular Zoom room.

courses.title: Everyday Caring
courses.description: A weekly Sunday gathering after morning zazen, hosted by two senior members, where practitioners share and talk through the difficulties of the present moment. Held on Zoom; a donation of about $10 is suggested.

courses.title: Zen Training and Core Practice
courses.description: The foundation's main path of study: a weekly Dharma seminar, monthly all-day sittings, study groups, sesshin and a yearly practice period, held in person and on Zoom. Students are encouraged to sit daily, meet a teacher in practice interview and, in time, receive the precepts.

free_resources.title: Everyday Zen Teachings Archive
free_resources.description: A large searchable archive of recorded talks, mostly by Norman Fischer, on Dogen, the sutras, koans, the precepts, early Buddhism and Jewish meditation, plus guided meditations. Free to stream or download, with a suggested donation.
